fairness_control: Only the exact clip intersection available for all four embedding models was evaluated.
limitation: The original Kaggle-derived recordings may contain adjacent fragments from shared source recordings. Source-session IDs were not available, so its utterance-level folds can be optimistic. LibriSpeech and the original corpus also have different speaker counts; raw cross-dataset accuracy differences are descriptive, not a controlled ranking. Chance-normalized values are reported.
